description: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under different conditions, comparing their performance before and after introspection training, as well as a control condition. The horizontal axis represents the model categories, labeled as GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, while the vertical axis is labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00 in intervals of 0.25. Each model category is represented by a grouped set of three bars, colored gray, light blue, and dark blue, corresponding to the control, before introspection training, and after introspection training conditions, respectively. For GPT-4o, the gray control bar is approximately at 0.10, the light blue "before" bar is around 0.50, and the dark blue "after" bar is about 0.75; for GPT-4o-mini, the gray control bar is near 0.00, the light blue "before" bar is roughly 0.50, and the dark blue "after" bar is approximately 0.75. The bars are grouped by model, with no specific sorting within the groups, and error bars are present for each bar, indicating variability in the data.
